item.title: grateful graceful memories
item.description:
"we are our memory, we are that chimerical museum of shifting shapes, that pile of broken mirrors." — jorge luis borges
hello there, my dear anon friend, and happy friday the 13th! it's weird to realize that it's already november. one less year, and one more year. november's post will be about taking stock of this year, reflecting on the cycles that have ended, and welcoming the new life beginnin…

item.title: the future is about friendship
item.description:
"a friend may well be reckoned the masterpiece of nature." — ralph waldo emerson, on friendship
hello there, my dear old anon friend
today i want to talk a bit about something i have been thinking about quite a lot lately, perhaps as a result of all my experience traveling the world and meeting people of all sorts, cultures, backgrounds, and of my meditations on the meaning of existence and the…

item.title: prelude: this is d-day
item.description:
hello there, my dear anon friend artists, philosophers, youtubers, scientists, engineers all of you who have entered my life when i needed angels all of you who stay my friends now that i've my own wings
(and to all those who decided to part ways, my respectful goodbye; thanks for everything)
there is so much i want to tell you there is so much i want to show you
things i've been dreaming about…

item.title: hello starlit world
item.description:
hello my anon friend, if you are new here, welcome i'm that cool scholar always creating the sublime
in the years ahead, as i continue to grow my career, home, family, and all my dreams, i'll be talking about good books, films, music, art and all the beauties of this life; with you, here
i'll be documenting our journey and the party usually on friday nights or over the weekends
